title: Forgiveness and mercy
ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَعَافِهَا وَاعْفُ عَنْهَا
en: O Allah, forgive her, have mercy upon her, grant her well-being, and pardon her.
ref: Hadith 963 (funeral prayer; feminine forms adapted from the narrated masculine wording)
ctx: Taught by the Prophet ﷺ for a deceased Muslim, narrated by 'Awf ibn Malik.

title: For those who preceded us in faith
ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
tr: Rabbana-ghfir lana wa li-ikhwanina alladhina sabaquna bil-iman.
en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers and sisters who preceded us in faith.
ctx: A prayer of the believers who came after the earlier generations. The verse continues beyond this excerpt.

title: For parents
en: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.
ctx: This verse specifically refers to parents. It is included for those who wish to pray for their parents; it is not a dua specifically about a grandmother.

title: For me, my parents, and the believers
ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
tr: Rabbana-ghfir li wa li-walidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
en: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the reckoning takes place.
ctx: A supplication of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him).

title: Funeral prayer for the deceased (feminine forms)
ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَعَافِهَا وَاعْفُ عَنْهَا وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهَا وَوَسِّعْ مَدْخَلَهَا وَاغْسِلْهَا بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّهَا مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الْأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ
tr: Allahummaghfir laha, warhamha, wa 'afiha, wa'fu 'anha, wa akrim nuzulaha, wa wassi' madkhalaha, waghsilha bil-ma'i wath-thalji wal-barad, wa naqqiha minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas.
en: O Allah, forgive her, have mercy on her, grant her well-being, pardon her, honour her resting place, widen her entrance, wash her with water, snow and hail, and cleanse her of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt.
ref: Hadith 963 (the narration continues with further wording not included here)
ctx: Reported by 'Awf ibn Malik from the Prophet's funeral prayer. The feminine pronouns are a standard adaptation; please have a qualified imam confirm the wording before relying on this text.
